clean_seed_constraint.event: at least one alerted eligible pair in an attack=none validation seed
clean_seed_constraint.method: Clopper-Pearson exact one-sided binomial upper bound

logistic_regression.feature_definition: cumulative fraction of receiver-identity pair receptions in the shared evaluation window for which each plausibility check fired; the pair signal is the maximum fitted probability over these cumulative rate vectors
logistic_regression.fit_weighting: equal total weight per independent RNG seed block

selection_rule: maximize independent-seed macro F1 subject to the exact one-sided benign-seed alert-probability upper bound; each rule freezes its own native-scale threshold with a deterministic conservative tie-break
